reviews.text: These guys are awesome! They've been walking Benito (NUEVAYoL!) since he was 5 months old, and he loves every walk. Plus the photo updates and reports after each trip give us so much peace of mind. Highly recommend their service!

Note the overwhelming number of the positive reviews are for boarding. I only used Lucky Dog for a limited number of walks before I was dismissed as a client, apparently because Andrew can’t handle anything other than positive feedback.

Andrew did the consultation & first week of walks & it was fine. John then took over the walks &  the problems began. My dog can be a standoffish with strangers in my apt. & rather than take it slowly, John ignored all the signs of his discomfort to drag him outside. I raised some concerns with Andrew after a walk where John was recorded trying to get my dog out for a walk while raising his voice to what I thought was an unacceptable tone & volume, with one leg holding the apartment door open while he was trying to lasso the dog. My dog’s tail was as far up between his legs as it could possibly be.

It was alarming to see a dog walker interacting with a dog showing obvious signs of discomfort this way. If he were more patient & let my dog get a bit more comfortable w/him, my dog would have been excited to see him within a few visits. When I paid my invoice that day, I noticed the price of walks had increased from $30 to $35 w/no notice. Andrew replied to my inquiry about this by taking a screenshot of an email that was sent prior to me becoming a customer, advising customers that the price was going to increase, basically acknowledging that I had no prior notice of the increase. I also raised the fact at this time that John had not actually been spending the 30 min I was paying for with my dog. The icing on the cake this day was that John also broke a glass bottle in my bathroom while moving about frantically, as he was wont to do. Lucky for me, he left the broken glass in my bathroom sink for me to throw away later.

John’s transportation was allegedly stolen on 6/15 and scheduled walk was very late that day. On, 6/17, I had a walk scheduled for 2-2:30pm. At 2pm, John texted me to say he was running behind and had two 30 min walks before getting to my dog but he would keep in touch about his ETA. At 3:40ish, he had not provided an update & when I inquired, he said he was waiting for the bus & would arrive in about 40 min, at 4:20 or possibly even later. I found this unacceptable, as the afternoon booking window for Lucky Dog is 1pm-4pm. I don’t need someone coming to walk my dog 1-2 hrs before I’m going to be home. I told him not to even bother (he responded and said he was already on the bus?? Oh, you’re ONLY a 40 minute bus ride away??)

I canceled subsequent walks & cited the fact that it seems punctuality is going to be an issue in the immediate future while John is relying on public transit. Figuring out how to complete previously scheduled & confirmed walks is something that Andrew needed to sort out after 6/15, not me.

I had boarding booked for 6/20. Andrew unilaterally canceled the previously confirmed & entirely unrelated boarding booking when canceling the walks that I had requested be canceled, processed a payment for the last walk using a payment method, & deleted my account/locked me out of the pet portal (and I found later blocked me on Instagram, like a preteen girl might) all before ever communicating any of this to me. He previously raised Qs about boarding that seemed like fishing for a reason to cancel anyway, so I wasn’t surprised. The way that I was “fired” as a client was totally unprofessional.

There is no contract that delineates the terms of service & I really started to think about the assignment of liability. When I saw John pushing my dog’s boundaries, it occurred to me that if my dog were to bite him, there was nothing executed about liability/assumptions of risk or about liability if my dog were ever injured while in the care/custody of lucky dog. Reflecting on this fact is a huge red flag, especially if you’ve ever watched a single episode of judge Judy. The lack of any contract/recourse that I have now that he canceled a previously confirmed boarding on such short notice, as I obviously have been damaged from my reliance on that confirmed booking.

Highly recommended!
Andrew is reliable, efficient, very flexible with scheduling, and truly caring.

We have two dogs—a Border Collie mix and a Pitbull—both very energetic and with some anxiety issues. From the very first minutes, I could tell Andrew really understands dogs. He took care of my pups for 10 days, keeping us reassured with photos, GPS tracking of their walks, and daily updates.

As a dog mom, he gave me complete peace of mind from the very first meet-and-greet and throughout the time I was away.

And of course, I have to mention that my dogs absolutely loved him too!

Thanks a lot!!

I can’t say enough good things about Andrew and his services. We left our dog with him for 8 days, and he took outstanding care of our little Hazel. We were grateful for the regular updates and photos, as well as his professionalism and flexibility. Highly recommend!
Jazz is normally really skiddish around new people but he took to Andrew very quickly and had a great time with him. Would highly recommend!

so let’s be clear i am 100 percent crazy helicopter dog mom. I made a decision to adopt a dog 2 months and then came the fears of i work a lot so who will help take care of her and allow to do the things i need to do without worry. i reached out to lucky dog and from the meet and greet to now i cant say enough amazing things. andrew and the team are super responsive and i truly feel like they care for penne like i care for penne. from staying  her when i travel for work to daily walks i can see her coming of her shell more and decompressing from shelter life and i know a lot of is due to all the amazing time she is spending with skyler and andrew. so thank you both and your team for helping me give penne the best quality of life!!

Andrew is such a safe and reliable walker and support system for us in Bensonhurst. We know we can count on him for flight delays, new anxious rescue dog training, making sure our cat doesn’t escape, etc. One of our dogs is highly sensitive to emotions and can pick up on someone anxious or rushing and will avoid that person. Andrew presents himself with a calm and confident energy that our dogs love and feel safe around. This is very important! All our walks are booked via an app and we can add comments or see already booked walks! Also payment is so easy via the app. It auto charges each Saturday. One less thing I need to worry about.

As the dog mom of a large, energetic rescue dog with a history of anxiety and reactivity, I seek out pet caretakers who are patient, reliable, and experienced. For my recent travels, I was hoping to find a boarder more local to my neighborhood, and I was thrilled to discover Lucky Dog, which serves neighborhoods throughout Brooklyn.

Getting in contact with Lucky Dog and scheduling a meet and greet was such a smooth, easy, and quick process! Scheduling, payment, and communications are all made simple via the mobile app, and I appreciate the quick response times and comprehensive photo/written updates I get in the app.

From the very first meeting, my dog took to Andrew right away and Andrew's calm, confident, and reassuring energy and dog expertise gave me so much comfort in booking my dog's stay and going away for two weeks. Andrew is highly reliable, consistent in his communications, and flexible/accommodating with logistical matters -- he's such a professional but, most importantly, he's a dog whisperer! He got my dog acclimated and troubleshooted any issues that came up during my dog's trial boarding and full boarding stay. I could tell my dog had such a great time, developed a love for Andrew, and was being exercised and fed on a routine structure. As a pet parent, it meant the world to me to feel comfortable and confident about going away for two weeks.

The pet care my dog received was so attentive, trustworthy, and supportive of my dog's health and my own sanity! I'm so happy to have found Lucky Dog, and I look forward to continuing to work with Andrew and his team!

We recently left our energetic mini poodle, Rico, with Andrew for 8 days while we were away at Disney and Universal, and I cannot rave about the experience enough!

Rico is a high-energy puppy who thrives on structure, love, and play. We don’t have any local family who can take him for extended stays, so finding someone we could fully trust was a big deal. Andrew delivered on every level.

From the moment we dropped Rico off, we felt completely at ease. Andrew welcomed him into his home and made sure he was not just cared for, but truly loved. He kept Rico on his regular schedule, made sure he got plenty of exercise and attention, and sent us daily updates with photos through the app. It made being away so much easier knowing Rico was in great hands.

If you’re looking for someone who treats your dog like their own and gives you peace of mind while you’re away, Andrew is your person. We will absolutely be booking with him again!

Our 50-pound lab loved boarding with Lucky Dog! And we loved getting the daily updates and pictures while we were away for a week. We’re so happy to have found such a great place for our pup to stay while we are out of town; he’s definitely one lucky dog!

Andrew is the best sitter we’ve had to date! We left our 3 year old husky with him for a little over a week and felt completely at ease. Andrew is extremely communicative, kind and responsive—sends detailed daily updates and was always available for any questions or needs. He was happy to accommodate a last minute change to our return date (2 days later), which was a huge help. Most importantly, our boy absolutely loved Andrew and felt right at home with him! I can’t recommend Lucky Dog enough!

Edited to one star due to bad experience that made me stop using Andrew. Dog was ok but Andrew ended up not answering communications from 5pm until the following morning. This was a while ago but noticed I left a 5 star and wanted to adjust.

Very professional and caring service.
Price very affordable.

Andrew and his team are incredible on every level. Outstanding customer service/communication, extremely flexible (seriously 24/7), accomodating, and reliable. Andrew and his team always went above and beyond to do what was best for me and my doggie - too many examples to count. I especially love the pics and written updates on what my doggie did on his walkies. They should be professional pet photographers too!
It is such a blessing knowing your loved one will be safe, loved, and so well cared for when you need a hand. We are so lucky to have found Lucky Dog!!!

Andrew has been walking our 8 year old rescue hound regularly for the past few months. He has been completely reliable and a great communicator. We know Tippi is in good hands with him, and the ease of scheduling and communicating via his app is an added bonus.

Andrew watched our two dogs while we were traveling for a week. We started with an initial consult and meet-and-greet, where he could meet our dogs, learn their quirks and personalities, and understand their needs. Once we felt comfortable with each other, it was easy to book services whenever we needed. He was easy to communicate with and fast to reply. I also appreciated the Time to Pet app, making it simple to schedule, book, track, and pay for any walks requested. Will definitely work with again!

Andrew and the all walkers at lucky dog are great! They respect your house rules, take care of pup, send updates and have the most seamless payment methods. (You can pay by cc!) Andrew goes out of his way to make it work for last minute requests and most of all our dog is well taken care of.
Andrew is the best. Very professional and reliable. Most importantly, our little pup loves him :)
I am so grateful to have found Andrew and Lucky Dog. I was having issues finding someone that serviced my area. My dog loves them!
We signed up for dog walking during the end of my pregnancy and it has been a life saver! Our pup is super excited whenever Andrew is on the other side of the door.
